latest_release.name: v0.4.0
latest_release.body:
# 0.4.0 [2026-11-05]

This release contains some bug fixes for hybrid handling and cancellation, as well as integrating better with systemd and D-Bus.

Packagers can also now specify building individual parts of the project with build flags, and the `default` profile has been named to `release` to be more clear.

## Improvements

- build: Make daemon, credentialsd-ui, demo client and web extension optional
- build: Rename `default` profile to `release`.
- daemon: Don't log error if we get PresenceRequired over hybrid (Thank you, @michaelbeaumont!)
- daemon: Cancel ceremony if UI disappears (Thank you, @michaelbeaumont!)
- daemon: Fix UI service failing to launch when started manually instead of via D-Bus activation.
- daemon: Allow Firefox to contact daemon on more distros with different app IDs (Thank you, @michaelbeaumont!)
- daemon: Fix all subsequent requests being rejected after the UI failed to launch.
- daemon: Don't busy loop polling for NFC devices when NFC is enabled.
- daemon: Use systemd unit name to determine whether a caller is trusted. (Thank you, @NyCodeGHG!)
- daemon: Update to libwebauthn 0.11.0, with various PXP and attestation format improvements.
- daemon: Change to standardized PXP BLE length-prefixed framing.
- daemon: Send PXP shutdown on close to prevent Android clients from hanging.
- daemon: Fix hybrid cancellation handling
- ui: Add Bulgarian translation (Thank you, @salif!)
- webext: Try to read app ID from associated desktop entry (Thank you, @michaelbeaumont!)
- ui: Basic recovery from failed attempts to use devices (e.g. flaky bluetooth)

## What's Changed
* Cancellation part 2: Don't emit failed states on cancellation by @msirringhaus in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/223
* chore(deps): update chacha20 away from yanked version by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/235
* doc: Update security model by @iinuwa in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/236
* feat(webext): try to determine app_id from native messaging binary environment by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/234
* ui: Add Bulgarian translation by @salif in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/237
* feat: add more app IDs to trusted firefox clients by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/233
* docs: Handle LIBDIR distro differences for Firefox extension by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/238
* daemon: Cancel request when the UI fails to launch by @LucFauvel in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/240
* daemon: Skip UI service activation when already running by @LucFauvel in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/239
* Implement basic recovery from non-terminal errors by @msirringhaus in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/230
* daemon: Add pause between NFC polling by @iinuwa in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/241
* daemon: Use systemd to validate xdg-desktop-portal process by @iinuwa in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/242
* daemon: Cancel ceremony if UI disappears by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/243
* daemon: Don't log error if we get PresenceRequired over hybrid by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/247
* Split build features by @iinuwa in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/244
* Enable daemon by default by @iinuwa in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/250
* Bump libwebauthn to 0.11.0 by @AlfioEmanueleFresta in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/248
* fix: actually handle NonTerminatingCancellation error by @michaelbeaumont in https://github.com/linux-credentials/credentialsd/pull/249
* Release 0.4.0 by @iinuwa in https://github.com/l
